title: Prefix Stability Benchmarking and Rollout Gating for Cache Reuse
creator: Anika Shah
description: Build a repeatable benchmark and gating mechanism that quantifies semantic and structural changes introduced when requests hit the KV/prefix cache versus cold runs. This ticket covers creation of a prefix-stability benchmark suite, signal definitions (SemanticFlipRate, TokenAlignmentLoss, EntityDropRate), integration into canary pipelines, and a per-route gating policy that prevents unsafe cache-related config/model rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark harness that can replay live traffic and toggle cache reuse for each request (hit vs cold) producing paired outputs for analysis
Define and implement at least three automated signals: SemanticFlipRate (embed-cosine), TokenAlignmentLoss (token-level alignment score), and EntityDropRate (NER-based entity preservation)
Dashboard in Console showing per-route baselines and current canary deltas for the three signals
Canary gating rule implemented: block rollouts when SemanticFlipRate delta > 0.3% absolute OR relative increase > 5x for top-10% traffic buckets
Automated regression alert that triggers a PagerDuty-style incident when customer-facing routes cross thresholds during canary
Documentation (Confluence) with runbook and instructions for triage and manual override
decisions: Use embedding-based cosine similarity on SBERT-lite as primary semantic metric to reduce compute compared to full model embeddings
Consider a conservative default gating threshold (0.3% absolute SemanticFlipRate) for automated blocks; allow product teams to opt-in to relaxed thresholds per-route
Run paired replay with identical sampling seeds where possible; for non-deterministic samplers, normalize by expected sampling variance using synthetic bootstrap
progress_updates: 2026-02-22: Prototype replay harness implemented that can tag requests as 'hit' or 'cold' and capture paired responses. Initial throughput at 200 req/s with lightweight caching toggles.
2026-03-03: Embedding scorer integrated and calibrated on golden_v1 dataset; found baseline SemanticFlipRate ~0.04% across diverse workloads.
2026-03-07: Discovered sampling-induced divergence for top-k sampling at k>=20; added TokenAlignmentLoss to separate sampling noise from cache-induced semantic shifts.
2026-03-10: Initial dashboard scaffolded in Console; canary pipeline hook implemented to push metrics per-deployment. First internal canary run scheduled for 2026-03-15.
2026-03-12: Feedback from PM (Liam O'Neill): require per-customer baselines for enterprise tenants to avoid noisy global thresholds. Added per-tenant baseline plan to next steps.
next_steps: Complete integration tests for harness at 1k req/s to validate low-latency capture (by 2026-03-18)
Run first real canary on staging with synthetic traffic and collect 72-hour metrics (start 2026-03-15)
Implement per-tenant baseline collection and storage; add UI controls for route-level threshold overrides
Add a lightweight NER-based EntityDropRate detector and wire into alerting pipeline
Prepare PRD and stakeholder demo for Product/Support week of 2026-03-22

notes: Rationale: Past incidents show cache hits can silently change generated output with downstream business impact (pricing copy, legal clauses). This ticket aims to provide a measurable, automated safety net.
Trade-offs: Embedding-based metrics are cheaper but can miss small factual changes; we compensate by combining multiple orthogonal signals (entities + token alignment).
Rollout path: start with internal-only canaries -> staging customer group -> default block for production until thresholds are satisfied.
